about: Firmware Center ka catalogue — yahan firmware files HOST NAHI hotin, sirf official sources ke records hain (link + version + SHA-256 checksum). Asal file hamesha official source se download karo, phir is Center ke 'Checksum Verify' se us file ko record ke checksum se mila kar dekho — match ho tab hi flash ki taraf barho.
source_note: Catalogue source (records jama karne ki jagah): Hovatek Stock ROM Forum — Infinix / Tecno / Itel ke model-wise stock firmware + PAC records: https://www.hovatek.com/forum/forum-105-page-30.html — baqi brands ke liye un ki apni official support sites. Sirf official link darj karo; anjaan download sites ke links is catalogue me mat dalo (badli hui firmware phone bhi kharab karti hai aur dukaan ka naam bhi).
